scientific_interpretation: The primary grouped analysis identified Random Forest as the recall leader, while Logistic Regression produced the strongest overall discrimination and precision-recall performance. The recall difference was small relative to fold-level variability. Because model ranking changed under exact-duplicate sensitivity analysis and fold-level variability was substantial, the experiment did not establish a robust single superior classifier.
